title: Dry Season
blurb: The wells have failed and a heat wave is rolling in. Catch the pump valve the airship drops, fit it to a well, and hold three hot nights.

objective.text: Fit the New Pump Valve to a Well

telegram.title: The Wells Have Failed
telegram.body: WELLS FAILING ACROSS THE GULCH STOP HEAT WAVE INBOUND STOP REPLACEMENT PUMP VALVE DROPPING FROM THE SHIP STOP FIT IT TO A WELL BEFORE YOUR TOWERS RUN DRY STOP HOLD THREE NIGHTS STOP

build: Your pump valves cracked in the heat. Every well's bone dry till you fit a new one.
Kicking a crate overboard now. Mind your heads. Mind the crate more.
wave: Hold them off. No water, no crops. No crops, no supper.

build: Heat wave's coming. I'm selling ice at the casino. It's mostly water. Mostly.
wave: Hundred and ten in the shade. Turrets run hot. Pace your shots.

build: Barrels warp in this heat. The Board approves, so long as they warp upward.
wave: Last night of the heat. Keep that water flowing.

drop: Valve's down on the plateau. Look for the parachute.
pickup: Careful with that. It's the last good valve this side of Tucson.
delivered: Valve's fitted. The pumps are drinking again. Fine plumbing, ranchers.
reminder: That valve's still lying out there. The wells won't wait forever.
hold: Wave's done, but nobody's fitted that valve. Get it to a well!
win: Three dry nights held and the wells are flowing. Drinks are on Pearl.
lost: The heat took a house. Dust yourselves off. We'll try it again.

journal.title: Specimen Notes, No. 2
journal.body:
The bugs climb harder when the wells run low. They follow water up the rock like roots grown backwards.

Whatever sleeps below is thirsty. I find that a very unwelcome thought.

- E. Whitlow, Rail Car 9

headline_win: Wells Flow Again; Mesa Ranchers Beat the Heat
